prose: Big Tech is increasingly using residual value guarantees to keep AI spending off balance sheets, the Financial Times reports, giving Nvidia and Broadcom a way to support their customers' purchases. Wall Street has found a new way to turn tech giants' credit strength into cheaper funding for the AI build-out.
highlights: Residual value guarantees are increasingly used for off-balance-sheet AI spend.
The structures let Nvidia and Broadcom support customer purchases.
Wall Street is converting Big Tech credit strength into cheaper AI funding.
